source_text: Health-related motivations also feature prominently, with parents citing documented risks of circumcision complications—such as infection, excessive bleeding, or improper healing, which occur in approximately 0.4% of infant cases per comprehensive reviews—alongside concerns over acute pain and possible long-term psychological effects from early trauma.
